final_answer.key_evidence_summary: All 7 alerts share one window (18:14:37~18:16:27). Six are LATENCY_DEGRADATION ripples, and the only resource-level anomaly is ts-order-service: RESOURCE_SATURATION [cpu_cfs] Val: 0.226s (Throttled). Call-direction check via GetServiceDependencies shows ts-order-service is the sink (no downstream), and its direct callers ts-seat-service (+1870.9%), ts-preserve-service (p50 458->7565ms) and ts-gateway-service (+1174.4%) are all alerted, with the ripple continuing upward to ts-travel-service (+29927.2% p50) and ts-ui-dashboard (+1195.0%) - i.e. the latency alerts ripple from order-service. The pod_network_delay branch is excluded by L3's own conditions: for the largest-deviation service ts-travel-service its downstream server-side latencies are NOT clean (ts-basic-service p90 48.87->1327.27ms, ts-seat-service p90 78.90->1555.00ms) and a saturation row exists, and the added latency is not a fixed amount (p50 +2244ms vs p90 +8724ms). Node scope is excluded because alerted pods span worker-01/02/03 while many same-node pods (ts-travel2, ts-train, ts-route-plan, ts-voucher...) are clean. Object layer is fully excluded: all deployments AVAILABLE 1/1, all pods Running 2/2 with RESTARTS 0 for every alerted service, nodes all Ready, no FailedScheduling/FailedMount/image-pull/OOM events (only rolling-restart Killing/startup-probe noise), and no error logs for any candidate. Config confirms the mechanism: ts-order-service container limit cpu=500m is saturated while its logs show sustained CPU-heavy work (queryOrders over 3985 orders, getSoldTickets building lists of thousands of tickets), producing CFS throttling on that pod and the measured latency blow-up along seat->preserve->gateway->ui.

When several alerts fire at once the case is the **primary anomaly** — the service the other alerts ripple from: usually the deepest one in the call direction (its callers' latency is a consequence of it) carrying the largest deviation. A lone saturation row on a service that is not that epicenter is collateral noise — don't out-rank the leaf anomaly with it; apply the branches below to the primary anomaly, not to the loudest keyword.
2. **Deal with the case you land on:**

3. **Close by excluding the object layer.** The pods / deployments / services / endpoints / nodes listings show everything else healthy — RESTARTS 0, AVAILABLE 1/1, endpoints bound, nodes Ready, no mechanism events. apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-order-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-order-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-order-service
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ts-order-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-order-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-order-mysql
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        - configMapRef:
            name: rabbitmq
        ports:
        - containerPort: 12031
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 350Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 512Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 12031
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-order-service
spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 12031
  selector:
    app: ts-order-service

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-basic-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-basic-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-basic-service
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ts-basic-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-basic-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        ports:
        - containerPort: 15680
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 350Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 512Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 15680
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-basic-service
spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 15680
  selector:
    app: ts-basic-service
